about_the_game:
Long Description

A dinner invitation turns into a deadly game of wits.

When you arrive at a mysterious manor for an elegant meal, the doors lock behind you. Guests turn to statues, voices whisper through the walls, and the host’s motives grow more sinister with every course. You’re not here to eat… you’re here to solve your way out.

Key Features:

  • 🧩 Cinematic Escape-Room Puzzles – Each handcrafted challenge ties into the mystery, from cryptic logic problems to mechanical contraptions.

  • 🎬 Movie-Style Storytelling – Fully integrated cinematics reveal characters, motives, and hidden clues.

  • 🔍 Interconnected Clues – Every puzzle is part of a bigger web; solutions hint at the truth behind the dinner.

  • 🌗 Evolving Atmosphere – Shift from warm candlelit curiosity to tense, shadow-filled uncertainty as you progress.

  • 🎧 Immersive Audio & Feedback – Custom voice acting, ambient soundscapes, and visual cues reward your every breakthrough.

Will you uncover the truth before the final course is served? Or will you become part of the manor’s collection?

content_descriptors.notes: There is no physical violence but a psychological horror story, full of mystery.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500 or AMD Ryzen 5 1400
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 or AMD RX 570 (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Realtek HD Audio
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-8700K CPU @ 3.70GHz 3.70 GHz
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1080 TI
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Realtek HD Audio

short_description: A lavish dinner. A locked room. And a truth no one wants you to uncover. Meal: Mystery Escape Room is a cinematic puzzle adventure where every solved clue pulls you deeper into a web of secrets. Unravel an unforgettable night through story-driven escape-room challenges.
supported_languages:
English*, Spanish - Spain
*languages with full audio support
